scenarios.title: A finished claude agent in a background worktree shows a macOS banner titled "<repo> / <worktree> - Claude finished" with the last message as its body
scenarios.summary: No claude session fixture without the real claude CLI; a shell-session Stop hook gave the in-app toast but no macOS banner was observable.

scenarios.title: With Notification Sound set to Bong the banner is silent and the Bong sound plays at the chosen volume; with System Default the banner plays the system sound
scenarios.summary: The harness cannot hear audio, so the chosen sound can't be checked.

scenarios.title: While the Quirky window is minimized, an agent finishing in any worktree puts an amber dot beside the menu bar "Q"; restoring or focusing the window removes it
scenarios.summary: The menu bar item exists in AX but isn't visible on the crowded menu bar, and the harness sees only the Quirky window.

scenarios.title: The menu bar item's menu reads Show Quirky, Settings…, Quit Quirky; Settings… brings the window forward on the Notifications view
scenarios.summary: The menu bar item isn't visible on the crowded menu bar and the harness can't click outside the Quirky window.

scenarios.title: Turning Show Menu Bar Icon off in Settings > Notifications removes the menu bar item at once, and turning it on brings it back
scenarios.summary: The menu bar item isn't visible on the crowded menu bar, so removing and restoring it can't be observed.

scenarios.title: The Dock badge shows the number of unread worktrees plus pending asks (empty at zero) and is cleared when Quirky quits
scenarios.summary: The Dock has no window the harness can observe, so the badge can't be checked.
